test \"\$CI_COMMIT_SHA\" = 5470363fc33d7689890763a54eb0ee23ac8d84d2
# Heavy execution only; external readiness and online acceptance stay on the control host.
phase() { printf 'CYF_FLOW_PHASE %s wall=%s monotonic=' \"\$1\" \"\$(date -u +%FT%TZ)\"; cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime; }
phase runtime.begin
test \"\${CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME:-}\" = develop
test -n \"\${CI_COMMIT_SHA:-}\"
test \"\$(git rev-parse HEAD)\" = \"\$CI_COMMIT_SHA\"
# Release tests use the current tree. Asset/all profiles verify historical provenance.
case \"\${CYF_TEST_PROFILE:-release}\" in
  release) ;;
  assets|all)
    if test \"\$(git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository)\" = true; then
      git fetch --unshallow origin \"\$CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME\"
    fi
    test \"\$(git rev-parse HEAD)\" = \"\$CI_COMMIT_SHA\"
    ;;
  *) echo 'Unsupported CYF_TEST_PROFILE' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
printf 'CYF_SOURCE_CHECKOUT shallow=%s commit=%s tree=%s\\n' \"\$(git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository)\" \"\$(git rev-parse HEAD)\" \"\$(git rev-parse HEAD^{tree})\"
manager=
if test -x /usr/bin/dnf; then manager=/usr/bin/dnf; elif test -x /usr/bin/yum; then manager=/usr/bin/yum; fi
test -n \"\$manager\"
# The base image already provides most tools. Installing named packages
# unconditionally also upgrades them and pulls unrelated system dependencies.
missing_packages=
for package in ca-certificates curl tar xz git; do
  if ! rpm -q --quiet \"\$package\"; then
    missing_packages=\"\$missing_packages \$package\"
  fi
done
if test -n \"\$missing_packages\"; then
  # Intentional splitting: names come only from the fixed list above.
  \"\$manager\" -y --setopt=gpgcheck=1 --setopt=install_weak_deps=False install \$missing_packages
fi
for tool in curl tar xz git; do command -v \"\$tool\" >/dev/null; done
node_sha=6c172a9ab6718f7b801fb5a7bd486af2ee5e32758086a04b84fcce2aa77095e6
cache_root=\"\$HOME/.cache/cyf-test-runtime\"
node_archive=\"\$cache_root/node-\$node_sha\"
mkdir -p \"\$cache_root\"
if test -f \"\$node_archive\"; then
  printf '%s  %s\\n' \"\$node_sha\" \"\$node_archive\" | sha256sum -c -
else
  downloaded=0
  attempt=0
  for node_url in \\
    https://mirrors.aliyun.com/nodejs-release/v24.22.1/node-v24.22.1-linux-x64.tar.xz \\
    https://cdn.npmmirror.com/binaries/node/v24.22.1/node-v24.22.1-linux-x64.tar.xz \\
    https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.22.1/node-v24.22.1-linux-x64.tar.xz
  do
    attempt=\$((attempt + 1))
    partial=\"\$node_archive.\$.\${attempt}.partial\"
    test ! -e \"\$partial\"
    if curl --fail --location --retry 2 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 240 \"\$node_url\" --output \"\$partial\"; then
      printf '%s  %s\\n' \"\$node_sha\" \"\$partial\" | sha256sum -c -
      mv \"\$partial\" \"\$node_archive\"
      downloaded=1
      break
    fi
  done
  test \"\$downloaded\" = 1
fi
node_root=\"\$PWD/_cyf_node24\"
test ! -e \"\$node_root\"
mkdir \"\$node_root\"
tar -xJf \"\$node_archive\" -C \"\$node_root\"
export PATH=\"\$node_root/node-v24.22.1-linux-x64/bin:\$PATH\"
test \"\$(node --version)\" = v24.22.1
phase runtime.end
phase install.begin
npm ci --include=dev --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com/ --replace-registry-host=npmjs --fetch-retries=2 --fetch-retry-mintimeout=10000 --fetch-retry-maxtimeout=30000 --fetch-timeout=120000 --no-audit --no-fund
test -x node_modules/.bin/vite
test -f node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js
phase install.end
phase test.begin
npm run test
phase test.end
phase build.begin
npm run build
phase build.end
test -d dist
test -f mochawesome-report/mochawesome.html
test -f mochawesome-report/mochawesome.json
export_root=\"\$PWD/_cyf_web_develop_ci_export\"
test ! -e \"\$export_root\"
mkdir -m 700 \"\$export_root\"
cp -a dist \"\$export_root/dist\"
cp -a mochawesome-report \"\$export_root/mochawesome-report\"
printf '%s\\n' \"\$CI_COMMIT_SHA\" > \"\$export_root/source-commit.txt\"
git rev-parse HEAD^{tree} > \"\$export_root/source-tree.txt\"
node <<'CYF_MANIFEST'
// Runs after npm test/build. Publish only dist; keep test reports in Flow artifacts.
const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),crypto=require('crypto');
const root='_cyf_web_develop_ci_export', files=[];
function walk(dir){for(const e of fs.readdirSync(path.join(root,'dist',dir),{withFileTypes:true})){
 const relative=path.posix.join(dir,e.name), p=path.join(root,'dist',relative);
 if(e.isDirectory())walk(relative);
 else if(e.isFile()){const data=fs.readFileSync(p);files.push({path:relative,size:data.length,sha256:crypto.createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex')});}
 else throw Error('Unsupported dist entry: '+relative);
}}
walk('');
if(!files.some(x=>x.path==='index.html'))throw Error('Missing site entry');
const packageVersion=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')).version;
if(typeof packageVersion!=='string'||!/^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(?:-((?:0|[1-9][0-9]*|[0-9]*[A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*)(?:\\.(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*|[0-9]*[A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*))*))?(?:\\+([0-9A-Za-z-]+(?:\\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*))?\$/.test(packageVersion))throw Error('Invalid package version');
const m={schema_version:1,pipeline_id:process.env.PIPELINE_ID,run_id:process.env.BUILD_NUMBER,branch:process.env.CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME,commit:process.env.CI_COMMIT_SHA,package_version:packageVersion,files};
if(m.pipeline_id!=='4403172'||m.branch!=='develop'||!/^[1-9][0-9]*\$/.test(m.run_id)||!/^[0-9a-f]{40,64}\$/.test(m.commit))throw Error('Wrong Flow identity');
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root,'release.json'),JSON.stringify(m)+'\\n');
console.log('CYF_WEB_ARTIFACT '+JSON.stringify({pipeline:m.pipeline_id,run:m.run_id,commit:m.commit,files:files.length}));
CYF_MANIFEST
phase export.end
NATIVE_WEB_CI"
